hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom curve hook that enables 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (an ETH-wrapping token). It intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, takes input from the PoolManager, deposits or withdraws via the phiEth contract, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully bypass concentrated liquidity math. Direct liquidity additions are blocked.
